title: Identity Management Incident Response
description: Identity management system incidents affecting university access
immediate_actions: Assess impact on university access and security
Notify Pioneer University IT Operations team
Contact university administration for security impact assessment
investigation_steps: Review identity management system logs and status
Verify network connectivity to identity systems
resolution_steps: Restart identity management services following standard procedures
Implement authentication service fixes if needed
Apply identity system patches or configuration changes
Coordinate with identity vendor for complex issues
verification: Verify student and faculty authentication processes
Confirm with university staff that system is operational
escalation_contacts: Escalation Group: Pioneer University IT Operations
special_considerations: During examination periods, LMS and identity incidents are automatically treated as P1
Identity management is critical for university security and access
Coordinate with academic departments for minimal disruption
